confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation is less certain and assumes typical July (rainy-season, non-peak) rates with taxes and fees included. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (roughly 2.5-3x), since direct knowledge is weaker. FX provenance: 0.6947 is the RBA 16 October 2026 USD mid-point as reported by a third-party site (ozfinancehub.com.au). I did not open rba.gov.au, so source_url is the official RBA page where the rate is published, not a page I read. The 16 October figure may not have been published before generation time, since the RBA publishes after 4pm AEST.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against lower-cost mainland Southeast Asian tourist hubs such as Luang Prabang and Hoi An, and against Thai tourist cities outside Bangkok and peak-season Phuket. Assumes about 33 THB per USD for the local-currency conversion behind the estimates.
